properties.displayName: SOC-LAB-001 - High Impact Azure Resource Deletion
properties.description: Monitors successful deletion of selected high-impact Azure resources.
properties.query:
// SOC-LAB-001: High Impact Azure Resource Deletion
// Status: Live alert and incident validated
// Data source: AzureActivity
// Severity: Medium
// Test: Authorized deletion of an unassociated lab NSG

AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
| where OperationNameValue in~ (
    "MICROSOFT.COMPUTE/VIRTUALMACHINES/DELETE",
    "MICROSOFT.STORAGE/STORAGEACCOUNTS/DELETE",
    "MICROSOFT.NETWORK/NETWORKSECURITYGROUPS/DELETE",
    "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT/VAULTS/DELETE"
)
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success", "Succeeded")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Caller,
    CallerIpAddress,
    OperationNameValue,
    ResourceId,
    ResourceGroup,
    ActivityStatusValue,
    CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
